decisions.requirement: Every active user decision must be consumed by the current design or explicitly remain pending during design rebuild.
acceptance: No active decision can disappear from traceability.

decisions.requirement: A V2 feature build must fail closed unless project and feature gates explicitly permit it.
acceptance: Every cb6-v2-clean build workflow invokes the feature gate before build work.

decisions.requirement: At 200 m, traffic-signal marks should be slim, approximately the same visual size as at 500 m.
acceptance: Rebuilt design must consume this decision before signal implementation is enabled.

decisions.requirement: Traffic-signal coverage must include signals outside intersections and signals currently missing at some intersections.
acceptance: Rebuilt design must address acquisition completeness and real-device verification.

decisions.requirement: Signal behavior must be verified for update install as well as clean install; clean-install-only success is insufficient.
acceptance: Acceptance route contains both update-install and clean-install checks.

decisions.requirement: CoMaps standard functionality is preserved unless a CB6 requirement explicitly extends it.
acceptance: Rebuilt design identifies upstream-owned behavior and prohibits collateral replacement.

decisions.requirement: Map follows driving direction by default, supports north-lock toggle, and own-position presentation is lowered on screen without altering geographic GPS coordinates.
acceptance: Rebuilt design defines follow/north-lock/offset ownership and regression route.

decisions.requirement: Initial map scale is 200 m; no automatic scale is required and the previous user scale is remembered.
acceptance: Rebuilt design defines scale persistence and excludes unintended auto-scale behavior.

decisions.requirement: A NAVITIME-like current-road-name bar is presented near the bottom with orientation behavior controlled by CB6 UI settings.
acceptance: Rebuilt design uses existing routing/address state and defines lifecycle/fallback.

decisions.requirement: Convenience stores are always available as brand-specific icons without cluttering convenience-store text; static POI data should prefer native MWM when proven sufficient.
acceptance: Rebuilt design resolves native MWM evidence before any network duplicate path.

decisions.requirement: Fuel stations and required major facilities are presented through the CB6 POI strategy with scale-aware visibility and without unnecessary duplicate network POIs.
acceptance: Rebuilt design assigns authoritative data source, presentation and regression checks.

decisions.requirement: Stop signs are a dynamic road-control feature and should be shown only when relevant ahead of the vehicle.
acceptance: Rebuilt design defines acquisition, direction/distance filtering and independent mark ownership.

decisions.requirement: Japanese voice search feeds the stock CoMaps SearchEngine, with on-device recognition where available and a safe fallback; no parallel search database.
acceptance: Rebuilt design defines speech lifecycle, normalization, fallback and stock-result preservation.

decisions.requirement: CB6 routing may support a free-expressway-only policy inside native route calculation semantics; it must not post-filter an already calculated route.
acceptance: Rebuilt design proves native toll/access semantics before implementation.

decisions.requirement: Toll-fee display must use a traceable authoritative fee source/model and must not fabricate an exact fee from road class.
acceptance: Rebuilt design records source/version/update/offline policy before implementation.

decisions.requirement: Favorites synchronization, if implemented, preserves BookmarkManager as authority and uses item-level identity/conflict handling rather than destructive collection replacement.
acceptance: Rebuilt design defines identity, conflict and transport boundaries.

decisions.requirement: App startup and navigation lifecycle must restore correct current-location/follow presentation and preserve CB6 behavior across restart/return flows.
acceptance: Rebuilt design includes startup/restart/return state transitions and real-device acceptance.
